subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Pronouns as cohesive devices, the Wright brothers and timed reading
outcomes: Identify what pronouns refer to in a text
Understand the word 'pioneer' and use the right verb forms
Read against the clock and answer questions to check speed and accuracy

tf.s: Pronouns link phrases and sentences and help a text read smoothly.
tf.why: Pronouns are cohesive devices that connect ideas.

tf.s: In 'The airlines are trying to reduce emissions. They want to protect the environment.', 'They' refers to the emissions.
A pioneer is a person who is among the first to do something new.
tf.why: Pioneers open the way for others.

tf.s: A pronoun usually replaces a noun that was mentioned earlier.
tf.why: This avoids repeating the same noun.

tf.s: In timed reading, you should answer the questions while you are reading.
tf.why: Answer after you finish, so the questions do not distract you.

tf.s: WPM in timed reading stands for 'words per minute'.
Using the same noun again and again makes a text smoother than using pronouns.
tf.why: Repeating nouns sounds heavy; pronouns make the text flow.

tf.s: A pioneer is someone who copies an idea many years after others.
tf.why: A pioneer is among the first, not a late copier.

tf.s: Timed reading measures both how fast and how accurately you read.
tf.why: You record your speed and your score.

boxes.q: 'The airlines... They want to...' What does 'They' refer to?

o: One of the first to do something new

boxes.q: When do you answer questions in timed reading?
boxes.why: This keeps you focused on reading.

boxes.q: What are pronouns in a text called?
Who is one example of a pioneer in science?
boxes.why: Marie Curie was a pioneer in radioactivity.

boxes.q: What does a timed reading record?
boxes.why: You measure how fast and how well you read.

mcq.q: What do pronouns do in a text?
o: They link phrases and sentences and make a text read smoothly
They give the title of the text
They always start a new paragraph

mcq.q: Which person is the best example of a pioneer?
o: The first person to fly a new kind of plane
A passenger on a normal flight
A person who copies an old idea
mcq.why: A pioneer is among the first to do something new.

mcq.q: Why do we answer comprehension questions after finishing a timed reading?
o: So the questions do not distract from reading
So we can read more slowly
mcq.why: Reading first, then answering, gives a true speed score.

mcq.q: Which pair shows a noun and its verb?
mcq.why: 'Invention' is the noun and 'invent' is the verb.

mcq.q: 'Virgin Atlantic flew a plane partly powered by biofuel. It was the world's first commercial biofuel flight.' What does 'It' refer to?
'Scientists are testing biofuels because they produce less pollution than oil. Airlines want to use them.' What does 'them' refer to?
mcq.why: Airlines want to use the biofuels.

mcq.q: You read 600 words in 3 minutes. What is your reading speed?
Why is a pronoun better than repeating a noun? 'The plane took off. The plane flew to London. The plane landed.'
o: Using 'It' avoids repetition and makes the text smoother

mcq.q: How can you find what a pronoun refers to?
o: Look back in the text for the noun it replaces
Count the letters in the pronoun
mcq.why: Pronouns usually point back to an earlier noun.

mcq.q: Why are the Wright brothers good examples of pioneers?
o: They were among the first to do something new in flying
mcq.why: Pioneers are among the first in their field.
